What if we've misunderstood the prophecy for nearly 30 years?

Everyone assumes Harry Potter is the Chosen One... but what if Neville Longbottom actually fulfills every requirement first?

Today we're breaking down every line of Trelawney's prophecy, Voldemort's choices, Neville's role at the Battle of Hogwarts, and why Harry may never have been the prophecy's true subject after all.

Could Dumbledore—and all of us—have been reading it wrong?
